about: Round 8 (audio-modes): new events (hundred, hit wicket, caught behind, last ball, hat-trick ball, two in two, last-over boundary/wicket) and top-ups for the thin ones. English only. Generate with tools/gen_commentary_r8.py.
hundred: A hundred! What an innings from {bat}!
Three figures. Raise the bat, take the applause.
That's the century! The whole ground is on its feet.
A hundred, and he's made it look easy.
Hundred up for {bat}! A knock to remember.
hit_wicket: Oh no, he's trodden on his stumps! Hit wicket!
Went too deep in the crease and knocked the bails off.
Hit wicket! You don't see that very often.
caught_behind: A thin nick, and the keeper makes no mistake.
Feather of an edge, straight into the gloves.
Nicked off! That's the outside edge, and he's gone.
last_ball: Last ball. Everything comes down to this.
One ball left. Can he finish it?
Here it is, the final delivery of the match.
The bowler at the top of his mark. Last ball.
hat_trick_ball: He's on a hat-trick! The fielders crowd in.
Two in two. Can he make it three?
Hat-trick ball coming up. The crowd is roaring.
two_in_two: Two in two! The game has turned.
Back to back wickets. Momentum has swung.
Another one! Two wickets in two balls.
last_over_boundary: A boundary in the final over! That changes the equation.
Exactly what they needed in the last over.
The pressure shifts straight back to the bowler.
last_over_wicket: A wicket in the final over! Massive moment.
That could be the match right there.
Gone in the last over! The bowler is pumped.
start: Welcome to the APL. What a night for cricket.
A packed house, a good pitch, and two strong sides.
The players are ready. Let's get started.
Floodlights on, crowd in. Here we go.
stumped: Dragged wide, the batter misses, and the keeper does the rest.
Too far down the pitch, and stumped!
run_out: Run out! Never a run there.
He's been sent back, and he's short.
Brilliant fielding, and that's a run out!
no_ball: The front foot is over the line. Free hit next.
free_hit: Free hit. He can swing without fear.
Nothing to lose here. Free hit.
maiden: Six balls, no runs. The pressure is building.
big_over: What an over that was for the batting side!
Expensive over. The bowler will want to forget that.
Runs flowing in that over. The chase is on.
milestone_near: He's closing in on a fifty.
Just a few more for the half-century.
edge: Off the edge, and they get runs for it.
Not where he meant it, but it all counts.
dropped: A sitter, and it's gone down.
Put down! A life for the batter.
won: They've done it! What a finish!
A brilliant win, and fully deserved.
lost: So close, but not quite there.
They fought hard, but it wasn't to be.
